description: Reset a channel's permission overwrites to exactly match its parent category (Discord's 'sync permissions'). The channel must be inside a category. Requires the Manage Channels and Manage Roles permissions, and View Channel on the category: the tool refuses a category the bot cannot view, whose overwrites Discord may replace with a single @everyone View Channel deny. Returns a confirmation.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel to sync with its parent category.

name: discord_lock_channel_permissions
